title: Inference Engines for the Jetson Orin Nano Super 8GB — What Actually Runs, and What Actually Helps
summary: Which inference engine to run on a Jetson Orin Nano 8GB, argued against first-party measurements (36.8 tok/s at 0.8B, 14.3 at 4.7B): llama.cpp is the answer, TensorRT-LLM does not target this SKU, the datacenter tier is the wrong machine class — and the three biggest throughput levers are not engine swaps at all. Covers 27 engines in the dataset plus 3 missing (18,455★).
